mechanism: Two simultaneous fixed missions compete for a three-aircraft mixed-type pool; reversing only MissionType.PRI selects which mission gets the available complete A+B pair before launch.

configuration.both_require: two systems with one minimum A and one minimum B

hypotheses_to_test: Only the higher-priority mission obtains a complete A+B pair, prepares, launches at hour 8 and completes at hour 10.
The lower-priority mission cannot reach its required A+B minimum within its admissible launch window and cancels; the exact native cancellation timestamp is to be observed.
Swapping only the two priority values reverses the winning mission without changing aircraft, resource, stock, failure, or PM inputs.
Native event and half-hour report ledgers reconcile each mission, system preparation (including any partial low-priority assignment), operation, cancellation, and terminal ready state.
limits: This pair tests priority under simultaneous calls and a fixed mixed-type minimum; it does not infer generic ready, soon-ready or confiscation order.
B04 return/turnround is an accepted instructional prerequisite but is not exercised in this slice.
Equal priority, active preparation confiscation, noncritical faults, resource waiting, later readiness, GUI-specific behavior, and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
